overview: A dark control-room traffic surveillance dashboard for monitoring cameras, reviewing uploaded traffic video, tracking detections and managing accident incidents and emergency alerts.
features: Live CCTV monitoring panel that plays a camera's uploaded MP4/AVI clip with full playback controls
Honest frame and vehicle counters driven by real playback and stored detection logs
Simulated vehicle detection boxes and accident analysis, clearly labelled as simulated
Incident records with camera ID, location and timestamp
Emergency alert dashboard with police and hospital notification status
Camera, incident, alert, analytics and location management pages
